findings.motion: Veto Override, Roll Call #596 (Senate Bill 747, Elections Law Changes)
findings.note: House roll call on overriding the Governor's veto of SB 747 (passed 72 to 44). The roll call lists von Haefen among the Noes. The ratified bill text (ncleg.gov/Sessions/2023/Bills/Senate/PDF/S747v5.pdf) includes provisions that require photo identification for same-day registration at early voting, a photo ID check as a ground for challenging a voter, and notation of the type of ID proof shown.

findings.motion: Second Reading, Roll Call #758 (House Bill 958, Election Law Changes)
findings.note: House second-reading vote on HB 958, a broad elections bill. The roll call lists von Haefen among the Noes. The bill text (Eighth Edition) includes a requirement that a voter registration application affirmatively state US citizenship, a sworn citizenship statement when the answer is blank, citizenship questions at drivers license offices, and a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database.

findings.motion: Motion 11 Concur, Roll Call #801 (House Bill 958, Election Law Changes)
findings.note: House vote to concur in the Senate version of HB 958 (passed 62 to 47). The roll call lists von Haefen among the Noes. The bill was vetoed 08/17/2026 per the bill page. Provisions on citizenship on registration forms and removal of possible non-citizens from voter rolls are described in the second-reading entry.
